Modular Reikland Line Infantry

Reikland Line Infantry are the professional career soldiers form Reikland province of the Empire, they are volunteery and very well discipline unit. These soldiers are the main units that Reikland provides to the Empirium, other provinces can also request or hire them from the governing body of Reikland.

In the regiment there are three ranks, Riflemen, NCO, Sergeant and ceremonial rank Drummer.

My idea behind this is to modernized old Empire Hand Gunners, now they use armor and bolt action rifles. Company captains are now officers, Lords are now generals shooting their black powder revolvers instead of the flintlock pistols. Scale is very close to the old minis.

Hollowed and supported on chitubox for your printing convenience. Please enjoy and I'll be happy for your feed back

I had to go far away from dwarves for some times and I decided to start some models for the High Elf Army. Many models we can find on website are either PLA friendly and ugly or Resin printer made and beautiful.

I worked on a very well known resin model to extract whatever I could use and complete with other stuff. Heads are printed separately and the result is quiet nice. It permits to give some randomness to the unit. Hopefully, High Elf Armies are somehow very strict in their appearance and uniforms (like in the Lord of the Rings in which Elves even move at the same time in a coherent ballet).
Swords need some works with sandpaper or stuff like that for a better shape result as they are very thin.

The whole unit was hard to paint because of the tiny details everywhere but it deserved a clean treatment.

PS: the standard is handmade.

Functional chest piece open in the front (no need for helper to put it on) made of a short skirted and short sleeved historical inspired gambeson.
